correctness.rationale: The product-cell definition enforces adjacent colour-set disjointness; a nonidentity dihedral rotation or reflection cannot stabilize any cell because respectively all five coordinate sets would agree or a reflection fixes an edge setwise with disjoint adjacent sets. Independently enumerated all five-colour valid cells and ten-element dihedral orbits: product counts (1020,5700,13000,15000,8750,2070), quotient count 4,554 and no nonfree orbit. Examined the exact quotient boundary code including simplex-face signs and Koszul signs for permuted factors; it verifies d^2=0 and performs integral unimodular unit-pivot elimination, followed by a complete rank-one residual certificate, not merely finite-field ranks. Its supplied integer Smith factors are 2 in boundary degree 2, 5 in degree 4 and 2 in degree 5, with ranks (101,469,831,668,207). Universal coefficients and free image of each boundary yield exactly the stated torsion and the single free H3. Quotient Euler and group-action freeness independently match.
residual_risks: Full 4,554-cell quotient Smith reduction was inspected in code and recorded integer certificate but not independently rerun in this execution; independent work certified orbit freeness and cell ranks only.
